description: Test suite for command-related utility functions such as resolveNativeSkillsEnabled, resolveNativeCommandsEnabled, isNativeCommandsExplicitlyDisabled, isRestartEnabled, and isCommandFlagEnabled. It uses 'vitest' testing framework to validate provider configuration heuristics and feature flags within a plugin system.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Sets up a test registry with plugins for various providers before each test case.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for each function being tested.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases testing specific behavior or scenarios.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Verifies that the actual output matches the expected result.
